metadata.title: Lot 9 - Recettes du Coeur preflight machine checklist

gates.name: Framework / metier separation contract
acceptance: No Recettes-du-Coeur-specific rule is embedded in generic framework runtime.
Business data, config, assets, compositions and generated web remain outside the generic framework.

gates.name: Structured data schemas validated
acceptance: collection.schema.json positive and negative fixtures pass.
data-registry.schema.json positive and negative fixtures pass.
relation.schema.json positive and negative fixtures pass.
Identifier and relation compatibility is documented.

gates.name: Search / Filter / Table data path robust enough for vertical slice
gates.coordination_context: Issue #1 also reserves SearchWiz / FilterWiz test work to agent B.
acceptance: Recipe search works on representative fields.
Combined filters support the required AND/OR cases.
Result sets can be rendered as table/list/gallery without business-specific code.

gates.name: Media and QR robustness
acceptance: Missing-image fallback is deterministic.
Image ratio/object-fit options tolerate invalid or absent values.
Recipe and tip URLs can be converted to reproducible QR payloads.
QR behavior remains safe when an encoder is unavailable.

gates.name: SEO and Share contracts
acceptance: Canonical URL and metadata contracts are deterministic.
JSON-LD generation has defined fallbacks.
Share payload and URL fallback behavior works outside browser APIs.

gates.name: Runtime observability
acceptance: Framework/runtime errors are retained with bounded history.
Events and counters can be inspected during the crash-test.
A clear/reset path exists for repeated test runs.

gates.name: Validated UX reference for promoted runtime
acceptance: The human validation milestone is explicitly closed for the chosen reference.
Any blocking V20 correction is resolved before promotion.

gates.name: Recettes du Coeur source data accessible and inventoried
acceptance: Recipe and ingredient datasets are accessible.
Categories, tags, allergens, seasonality, equipment and tips are inventoried.
Media paths and public-site configuration are inventoried.
Each JSON source has version/data-dictionary information or an explicit migration note.

gates.name: Vertical slice contract defined
acceptance: Load a real recipe subset and linked ingredients.
Render recipe index and recipe detail.
Provide search and a minimal filter set.
Handle image fallback and generate recipe QR.
Publish a preview before broadening the feature set.

gates.name: Preview publication policy available
acceptance: Crash-test output is published to a preview target before production.
Published snapshots remain immutable and identifiable.

gates.name: Multi-agent lock discipline active
acceptance: Every parallel task is reserved before modification.
No active file_scope overlap exists between agents.
roadmap.md is consolidated separately rather than edited concurrently.

safe_parallel_work: Inventory business datasets and mappings when the business repository is accessible.
Prepare representative fixtures without changing generic runtime.
Re-evaluate this checklist from live locks before starting the real vertical slice.

dictionnaire_donnees.description: Machine-readable Lot 9 entry checklist. Gate statuses are a coordination snapshot; live ownership/status must be re-read from coordination/locks before action.
